content:
Last month, reports surfaced that Apple is developing a brand-new, AI-powered shopping assistant for the Apple Store app on iPhone and iPad.

The company appears to be rolling out this feature to some users in the form of an "Early Preview".

Inside the Apple Store app, some users can now see a brand-new chat-style icon in the lower right corner, replacing the traditional search icon. After entering the page, users can search for products or start a conversation with a "virtual shopping assistant".

Suggested prompts provided by the system include:

  • The latest Apple products
  • Check my trade-in value
  • Explain carrier offers
  • Help me choose a watch
  • iPhone monthly instalment plans
  • Compare iPad models

The image above was provided by X user ShrimpApplePro, giving us our first look at the new design.

Apple explains in the fine print:

Not all users will have access to the shopping assistant within the Apple Store app. Apple says it is currently opening it to some users only in the form of an "Early Preview", and has not disclosed when a full rollout will take place.

What are your thoughts on Apple adding a brand-new AI assistant to the Apple Store app? Will you use it? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
